judgements.justification: B's two 6s rest on stated reservations (positioning against NQG, per-dataset tuning) that A never raised, so the gap reflects different judgements and one exuberant 9, not one committee scoring equal assessments more leniently.
Neither B's reviewers nor its AC called the headline claim or title overstated or asked to narrow it; B's poster followed the 6.75 mean and reservations about NQG positioning and tuning.
B's 6s came from Reviewer_9RED and Reviewer_sHgm at confidence 3 and 4 with specific technical objections; the one unsure reviewer (Reviewer_LKem, confidence 2) rated 7, and B also had an 8.
